Reject nonpublic or malformed remote MCP endpoints, retain delegated evaluator failure reasons, and cover verified review-policy bindings. Classify offline adversarial fixture generators as test sources without changing quality thresholds. Capture bounded first-failure diagnostics in the installed native probe without retrying or extending deadlines.

Signed-off-by: Michael Kantor <6068672+kantorcodes@users.noreply.github.com>

* test(ci): reconcile the exact offline-fixture Sonar scope

Retain the production Rust source and quality assertions while accounting for the two offline adversarial fixture generators as test tooling. The stale exact-string assertion reproduces before this correction; all four scope/shard contracts pass afterward.

Signed-off-by: Michael Kantor <6068672+kantorcodes@users.noreply.github.com>

* test(native): retain bounded resident error diagnostics

Record only allowlisted Rust error-envelope codes when the native edge fails closed, so installed-platform probes can distinguish policy-generation and transport failures without exposing raw stderr or payload data.

Signed-off-by: Michael Kantor <6068672+kantorcodes@users.noreply.github.com>

* deps: upgrade anyio to 4.14.2

Resolve CVE-2026-63374 without changing the surrounding dependency graph.

Signed-off-by: Michael Kantor <6068672+kantorcodes@users.noreply.github.com>

* test(native): separate restart recovery from latency SLO

Keep the functional cold-restart test bounded without reusing the 750 ms warm-hook deadline. Installed daemon recovery latency remains enforced by the native-wheel SLO gate.

Signed-off-by: Michael Kantor <6068672+kantorcodes@users.noreply.github.com>
